notes: Discover, Studio and Tools come back where you left them. Scroll down the search results, open a tool, go and play something, come back — each tab is where you left it, and it still is after a refresh, because the position is kept on the device rather than for the session.

The downloader keeps your link. Paste an album, start it, and the link stays in the box — if the app is reloaded while it runs (an update, a crash, the system closing it), the downloader starts that album again on its own, straight away.

An interrupted run resumes the songs that never landed, not the whole album: the run writes down the song list it is working through and which of them are in your library, so nothing is downloaded twice and nothing is silently dropped.

A song that cannot be found is tried twice on the next starts and then left to you: the link stays in the box and one tap starts it again by hand, so a song nobody can source never begins a download on every single launch.
Cancel means gone: stopping a download clears what was written down, so the next start never quietly begins the run you stopped.

The build that only takes the files you already own has no downloader and no converter in it at all now — the tools are removed from the app rather than hidden away — and the update notes it shows never mention one.
